changes.name: Microsoft Copilot for Powerpoint Masterclass
changes.prerequisite:
Prerequisite

Basic computer and file-management skills are expected. Familiarity with basic PowerPoint editing and slide creation will help you follow the exercises.

Software Requirement

You will need the following for this course:

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot – confirm training-account availability with the trainer

Install and test the listed software before class. Confirm the required version and account or licence access in your joining instructions. Cloud and AI services may charge subscription or usage fees.

Hardware Requirement

Bring a Windows or Mac laptop supported by the listed software, with a working keyboard and sufficient storage for course exercises.

Bring your own computer and charger, with a reliable internet connection and permission to install the required software. For live online classes, also prepare a microphone or headset.

If you need help arranging a suitable device, contact us before the class to confirm availability.

How to Apply for HRD Corp Funding

For employer-sponsored training in Malaysia, ask us to confirm the HRD Corp programme registration and eligibility for Microsoft Copilot for Powerpoint Masterclass (C012). Funding depends on employer eligibility, levy availability and HRD Corp approval; it is not automatic.

  1. Request the quotation, course outline, training schedule, trainer profile and registered programme details from us.
  2. Your employer submits the grant application through e-TRiS under HRD Corp Claimable Courses, using the confirmed programme details and supporting documents.
  3. Allow time for approval before training: public courses currently require three days after approval through 31 December 2026; from 1 January 2027, 14 days apply. In-house training requires 14 days after approval.
  4. Confirm the approved dates and grant reference with us before attending. Complete the attendance and training requirements and retain claim documents.
  5. Coordinate the claim with your employer and training provider within six months after completion.

Check the current HRD Corp requirements and allowable costs before applying.
